name: True Memory

paper.title: Storage Is Not Memory: A Retrieval-Centered Architecture for Agent Recall

stages.ingestion: An encoding gate (gzip-based novelty, salience, embedding prediction error) admits or rejects each event; it is disabled (every event admitted) in all reported benchmark numbers. Admitted events are written verbatim to a SQLite messages table with FTS5 and 256-d sqlite-vec indices.
stages.construction: Post-ingestion batch jobs build an L5 per-event surprise score and an L0 speaker engram (preference attribute map + char-n-gram style vector).
stages.organization: Single SQLite file: verbatim messages plus side tables (summaries, contradiction records, timelines, entity profiles, surprise scores, episodes).
stages.update: L4 consolidator produces cluster summaries, contradiction records and timeline rows with superseded-by links, kept alongside the verbatim events.
stages.retrieval: FTS5 BM25 and dense top-k fused by weighted RRF (k=60), reweighted by conditional temporal boost, speaker-engram prior and surprise boost, then cross-encoder rerank (pre-rerank window 100) with modality factor; top-k (default 10) to the answer model. Pro tier adds HyDE query expansion.
stages.answer: gpt-4.1-mini answers from the retrieved top-k (temperature 0, max 200 tokens).

summary: Retrieval-centered memory over verbatim events in a single SQLite file (BM25+dense RRF, salience/engram reweighting, cross-encoder rerank), arguing extraction at ingestion is the wrong primitive.
notes: Authors: Joshua Adler, Guy Zehavi (Sauron Labs). Three tiers: Edge (Model2Vec potion-base-8M + ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2), Base (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B@256d + gte-reranker-modernbert-base), Pro (= Base + HyDE query expansion). All scores use a semantic-match judge that the authors say is more lenient than strict-match; absolute numbers not comparable to strict-match baselines. AXES-CHECK: seed taxonomy row consistent; paper adds an ingestion gate (disabled in benchmarks), L3 salience/L0 speaker-prior reweighting and HyDE (Pro) at selection time.
